dedupe_keys.name: open mastr german energy registry client

description: open-mastr is a Python package for accessing and processing Germany’s Marktstammdatenregister energy-unit registry. It downloads registry releases, parses the large files into a local database and supports updates and analysis. The coverage is German registered energy assets and the reference date follows the selected MaStR release; the package does not create new plant observations. Its public repository and documentation are AGPL-3.0. The processed asset table can help build electricity-generation or network scenarios and compare changes in energy infrastructure. A caveat is that registry reporting completeness and update timing still need checks, and storing the full registry may require substantial disk space. The catalogue data-marktstammdatenregister-mastr-germany describes the source data; this software is a separate reuse route. No first-review software draft was found. The JOSS article and own repository were read without downloading the registry.
name: open-mastr German energy-registry client
